digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions mirror CI for main branch health reporting
propositions: Cancelled runs on push to main render as red X on GitHub despite main being healthy, because concurrency groups collapse superseded runs and GitHub provides no native suppression.
Mirror CI on main should switch from push-triggered per-commit to scheduled 6-hourly runs, removing cancellations by construction while accepting a multi-commit regression window.
Last-known-green main SHA must be resolved from GitHub Actions API and published in run summary to bound bisect search; unresolvable bounds degrade gracefully with visible placeholder.
Bisect remediation recipe (git bisect start + git bisect run reproducing CI) must be copy-pasteable into run summary on failure, with both bad and good SHA filled in.
Pre-merge Gerrit Verified gate is unchanged; mirror CI is a safety net only, never a merge blocker, so trigger policy change carries no gating risk.
Push CI for non-main branches and all out-of-scope workflows (gerrit-verify.yaml, reconcilers, external-integration.yml, reusables) remain byte-identical.
